statements.text: Hybrid cosmopsychism needs a law fixing when local subjects exist and a law ensuring they inherit a thinned-out version of the experience in the region they occupy, only the aspects that realize the information structures introspection and neuroscience match to experience. Which conditions is an empirical question. With a modified integrated information theory, the subjects are the maxima of integrated information.

sources.quote: This is an empirical question, to be settled by our best theory concerning the physical correlates of local consciousness.
